architecture_decisions.rationale: Introduce a mechanism so that all request and app-context teardown callbacks run even if earlier ones raise exceptions. On Python 3.11+, collected errors should be raised as a BaseExceptionGroup; on older versions the first error should be re-raised. This prevents resource leaks when teardown handlers fail.

implementation_summary: This change implements 'Ensure all teardown callbacks are called despite errors' for the flask project. Introduce a mechanism so that all request and app-context teardown callbacks run even if earlier ones raise exceptions. On Python 3.11+, collected errors should be raised as a BaseExceptionGroup; on older versions the first error should be re-raised. This prevents resource leaks when teardown handlers fail. The implementation modifies 10 existing files (CHANGES.rst, docs/appcontext.rst, src/flask/app.py, src/flask/ctx.py, src/flask/helpers.py) and creates 0 new files. Create a context manager that collects errors from multiple callbacks without stopping execution Ensure all teardown callbacks run even if earlier ones raise exceptions On Python 3.11+, raise collected errors as a BaseExceptionGroup
